question: Bastar Dussehra is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chhattisgarh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bastar Dussehra is a festival celebrated in the Bastar district of **Chhattisgarh**, which is located in central India.
 
• The festival is celebrated for **75 days** and is known for its unique customs and traditions.
 
• The main attraction of the festival is the procession of the **local deities**, which is led by the king of Bastar.
 
• The festival is celebrated in the month of **October or November** and is considered to be one of the most important festivals in the state of Chhattisgarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh:** 

 
 
• This state is located in northern India and is known for its **rich cultural** heritage.
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Uttar Pradesh include **Diwali, Holi, and Eid**.
 
 
 
• **Haryana:**
 
 
• This state is located in northern India and is known for its **agricultural **heritage.
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Haryana include **Baisakhi, Teej, and Lohri**.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand:**
 
 
• This state is located in eastern India and is known for its **tribal culture**.
 
• Some of the popular festivals celebrated in Jharkhand include** Sarhul, Karma, and Sohrai**.
